findingDetails.title: Ten byte-identical inline containment call blocks duplicate the same options and message across four command YAMLs
findingDetails.evidence: The same six-option call and advisory message are copied at deep-research-auto.yaml:1244/1334/1424/1625, deep-research-confirm.yaml:1119, deep-review-auto.yaml:1521/1615/1705/1795 and deep-review-confirm.yaml:1191; two copies already carry stale comments and none can pass the mode option.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extract one shared helper that performs the call, prints the advisory and returns the result, leaving each dispatch branch a one-line invocation.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Printed all ten call blocks and compared them; verified the runtime guard is the single tested implementation while the call-site envelope has no test.

findingDetails.title: The index-lock contention warning is drained only by the fan-out runner
findingDetails.evidence: drainGitContentionWarnings is exported at write-containment.ts:312 and called only at fanout-run.cjs:3171; the ten inline callers never drain, so an exhausted retry budget in an inline iteration is recorded and silently discarded.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drain and log inside the shared helper, or log at record time inside the guard.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Grepped every caller of drainGitContentionWarnings across the runtime; one drain site exists.

findingDetails.title: The decision record's supersession chain leaves two removed-mechanism ADRs looking live
findingDetails.evidence: ADR-003 (detached ephemeral lane) remains Status Proposed at :234-240 though implemented in phase 4 and deleted in phase 7; ADR-005 (checkout watch for isolated lanes) remains Status Accepted at :466-472 though no isolated lanes exist; ADR-007 :540-542 names only ADR-004 and ADR-006.
findingDetails.recommendation: Mark ADR-003 Withdrawn/Superseded and ADR-005 Superseded by ADR-007; extend ADR-007's note to cover both.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read every ADR status and the supersession notes in ADR-006 and ADR-007; cross-checked the removed code paths.

findingDetails.title: The artifact-scope containment rule is implemented twice with no shared helper
findingDetails.evidence: The cli-opencode guard defines canonicalLocation/escapesArtifactDir (:1328-1360) implementing the same name-plus-canonical rule as isContainedInArtifact in write-containment.ts:574-596, but the module's helper is not exported so the YAML reimplements it with a copied rationale comment.
findingDetails.recommendation: Export the canonicalization helper from the module and call it from the command guard.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read both implementations and the module's export list; confirmed the helper is internal and the guard cannot import it.

findingDetails.title: The runtime fan-out catalog entry is stale and names its third CLI kind twice
findingDetails.evidence: The entry lists '(opencode, claude, opencode)' at :3 and 'cli-opencode, cli-claude-code, cli-opencode' at :42 while the code maps cli-codex as the third kind (fanout-run.cjs:473-475); its HOW-IT-WORKS section (:40-59) predates containment enforcement, the churn sampler, the advisory status and the index-lock retry; the file was untouched in the reviewed range while the hub catalog entry was migrated by ca713e3478.
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct the kind list and add the driver's post-045 responsibilities, or point related references at the hub containment entry explicitly.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared the entry's claims against the kind map and the post-045 runner behavior; checked the file's history in the reviewed range.
